name: Nova City Docks
flavor: The lawless orbital sprawl you call home. Everything starts and ends here.

name: The Rust Ring
flavor: A derelict shipbreaking ring where salvagers pick over the bones of dead freighters.

name: Keth Station
flavor: A grey-market waystation where nobody asks where the cargo came from.

name: Verdant Belt
flavor: An agri-drone colony ring, greenhouses under glass, quietly rich.

name: Obsidian Drift
flavor: A pirate haven lashed together from stolen hulls. Trust no one.

name: Halcyon Spire
flavor: A gleaming corporate tower-station. Security is excellent; so is the loot.

name: The Hollows
flavor: A vast wreck field swallowed by a dead nebula. Things still move out there.

name: Frostgate
flavor: An ice-mining outpost on a frozen moon, cold enough to crack hull plating.
